description:
You are the new IT Manager at Pacific Northwest Medical Center. The organization recently deployed FreeScout as their internal IT support help desk, but the system is still using default settings.

Navigate to the system settings (Manage > Settings) and configure the following:

1. Company Name: Pacific Northwest Medical Center - IT Support
2. Timezone: America/Los_Angeles (US Pacific Time)
3. Time Format: 12-hour format (with AM/PM)

Make sure to save the settings after making all changes.

FreeScout admin login:
- URL: http://localhost:8080
- Email: admin@helpdesk.local
- Password: Admin123!

metadata.expected_company_name: Pacific Northwest Medical Center - IT Support
